name: You get accused of half a degree murder
source:
You wake up in an interview room, with the STRONGEST looking guard you've seen in your life, and he threatens to imprison you for the murder of a very important person.

[From [url=https://ynerva.itch.io/you-get-accused-of-half-a-degree-murder]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在审讯室醒来，周围是你一生中见过的最强大的警卫，他威胁要因为你谋杀了一个非常重要的人而监禁你。

[来自[url=https://ynerva.itch.io/you-get-accused-of-half-a-degree-murder]Itch.io[/url]]
